status: Proposal only, no new native execution or GPU request
main_goal: Distinguish steered from untreated inference on unfamiliar questions. Treat ordinary-residual-only detection as the main statistical problem unless the user allows a trusted same-boundary expected-output channel.
mechanics_inspired_global_function: For the full computation state H and fixed prompt x, define E(H|x)=0.5*sum_(layer,step) r_(layer,step)^T*P_(layer,step)*r_(layer,step), where r=observed output - trusted unmodified block output on the same complete inputs/context/cache and P is positive definite. Include memory-update and input-boundary consistency if those intervention sites are in scope. A normal deterministic forward pass satisfies the constraints; an additive change at an observed boundary gives a nonzero local residual. This defines a constraint energy, not proof of physical potential or gradient-descent inference.
trusted_instrumentation_track: Use the already implemented boundary_energy function. Expected output must be captured before the monitored intervention or recomputed with the actual same state. Never compare adjacent layers directly as if normal layer updates were zero. Next validation must use fresh task families, signs/directions/strengths, no-op hooks, ordinary prompt changes, numerical precision controls and multiple monitored sites. Exact zero threshold applies only to exact copied pre/post values; shadow replay needs a tolerance fixed from untreated controls, with cloned cache/state and unchanged kernels. Only after scope clarification prepare a bounded native resource plan.
ordinary_trace_track: All3 frozen energy candidates failed the current family holdouts. No deployable binary energy detector is validated. A next statistical study should use much broader BASE-only conditional calibration and, if supervised training is allowed, multiple training directions/signs plus complete held-out scenario and vector families. Existing known+v probe16/16 fresh validation remains a narrower lead; it does not establish arbitrary-direction detection. Fix false-alarm targets and calibration before TEST, measure misses and unsupported-context rates, and use an untouched prospective set.
neuroscience_transfer: Precision-weighted conditional prediction error is a sensible model class, but estimated confidence must include surrogate error and unfamiliar contexts. Today's leave-whole-prompt-out uncertainty estimation improved the experimental design without producing general detection. Do not relabel the failed prototype as successful or keep searching penalties on these same outcomes.
identifiability: If a modified run and an untreated run produce the same monitored residual trace, a classifier restricted to that trace cannot distinguish their causes. No energy analogy removes this information limit. Question, vector, strength, injection-layer and model generalization are separate tests.
resource_policy: Keep GPU released during review/design/CPU work. Existing study06 strength proposal stays unexecuted. Do not alter user CPU Drive mount or Research3 resources; no automatic campaigns, retries or model training.
